content: {"paper_id":"W4413398904","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"deep-clustering","exact_quote":"DSGAC: deep self-supervised global attention for attributed graph clustering","evidence_field":"title","reason_zh":"标题直接表明面向属性图聚类的深度自监督模型，使用可学习神经表示并生成聚类划分。"},{"keyword_id":"multi-view-learning","exact_quote":"integrate node attribute information and topological structure to cluster nodes exhibiting similar features and connectivity relationships","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"将同一节点的属性信息与拓扑结构作为两种观测视图显式联合利用以完成聚类。"},{"keyword_id":"graph-neural-networks","exact_quote":"The model primarily extracts global topological information by leveraging a global attention mechanism.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"用图上的全局注意力机制进行可学习的拓扑信息聚合，属于图上可学习消息传递获取表示。"},{"keyword_id":"pseudo-label-self-training","exact_quote":"the model employs the generated soft clustering assignments to consistently guide its iterative updates","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"将模型生成的软聚类分配作为后续迭代更新的训练信号，符合自训练/伪标签式迭代机制。"},{"keyword_id":"graph-manifold-regularization","exact_quote":"it introduces a Laplace smoothing filter to denoise and smooth node attribute features","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"使用拉普拉斯平滑滤波对节点属性特征按图结构进行去噪和平滑，体现几何一致性约束。"}],"abstentions":[],"input_issues":[]}
